name: xh

patches.old:
fetch()
{
    if which curl > /dev/null; then
        if [ "$#" -eq 2 ]; then curl -fL -o "$1" "$2"; else curl -fsSL "$1"; fi
    elif which wget > /dev/null; then
        if [ "$#" -eq 2 ]; then wget -O "$1" "$2"; else wget -nv -O - "$1"; fi
    else
        echo "Can't find curl or wget, can't download package"
        exit 1
    fi
}

releases=$(fetch https://api.github.com/repos/ducaale/xh/releases/latest)
url=$(echo "$releases" | grep -wo -m1 "https://.*$target.tar.gz" || true)
if ! test "$url"; then
    echo "Could not find release info"
    exit 1
fi

resources.checksum_source: locally-pinned after HTTPS download; not independent upstream verification

smoke: "$OFFLINE_PREFIX/bin/xh" --offline --ignore-stdin --print B POST https://example.invalid/demo message=shellferry > /tmp/xh-request; grep -q shellferry /tmp/xh-request
notes: Converts the official documented shell installation path with exact patches, pinned version and bundled resources.
Upstream source is fetched from a fixed Git commit at build time rather than vendored. Runtime software license remains upstream.
Pins the latest-release lookup and creates the explicit XH_BINDIR before preserving upstream move and xhs symlink installation.
